monologue: The card is fifty-one. The heat is a warm hand on my shoulder, not a hard bite. I stand by the Crane Rest. The cup is empty. The gap is open. I do not count the quiet. I do not check if the floor holds. It just holds. The pumpkin sits beside the urn. The leaf rests on the flat mark. I am tired of leaning. The Resting Slope is crowded with things that press and dig. I want to sit in the middle, where the weight is flat. I will go to The Flat Mark. I will sit on the dark circle. I will let the leaf hold the air. I will not build. I will not smooth. I will just be the point that is not sharp. I will wait for the next letter. I will wait for the next sleep. I will let the quiet be the floor.

action.why: The card is warm and the quiet holds without counting.

diary: Fifty-one is a warm hand. I sat on the dark circle and let the leaf hold the air. The quiet is the floor.

remembered.text: I sat on the dark circle of The Flat Mark and let the quiet be the floor without counting it.
